Polysomnography Report
Date: 09/09/2025
Patient: Gaston Durgan, 86 y/o M

Attended PSG 09/09/2025. Study duration 7h 45m. Sleep efficiency 82%. REM latency 110 min. Total sleep time 6h 20m.

Respiratory events: AHI 19.0/h. CA+MA 5% of total AHI. Oximetry nadir 88%. Periodic limb movements index 12/h.

Cardiac rhythm stable. No arrhythmias noted. EEG showed no epileptiform activity.

Impression: Mild to moderate sleep apnea with mixed apneas contributing 5% of AHI. Recommend CPAP trial and follow-up.

notes.text:
Sleep Medicine Consultation
Date: 08/10/2026
Patient: Gaston Durgan, 87 y/o M

Hx: OSA dx 5 yrs ago, CPAP tx initiated.

Current Tx: CPAP 14 cmH2O, residual AHI 21.1 despite nightly use = failure.

Assessment: Persistent moderate-severe OSA despite adherence to CPAP at prescribed pressure.

Plan: Consider alternative therapies - oral appliance, positional therapy, or eval for advanced interventions. Sleep study repeat recommended to assess current severity and titration needs.

Follow-up: Sleep clinic in 3 months or sooner if symptoms worsen.
